metadata.name: cow_settlement
metadata.description: CoW Protocol settlement program. Some of the properties and instructions of this program can't be represented via a standard IDL, please be careful to read the documentation on the function you are using.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the singleton settlement state PDA and the native SOL buffer. Succeeds only once, and only when signed by the hardcoded initializer.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the state PDA's and native SOL buffer's rent. Must be the hardcoded initializer.

accounts.name: state
docs: Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone. SETTLEMENT_SEED is the ASCII prefix "settlement v" followed by the program's major.minor version, right-padded with spaces to a fixed 19 bytes; the fixed width prevents one version's seeds from being a prefix of another's.

accounts.name: native_sol_buffer
docs: Canonical PDA seeded by [SETTLEMENT_SEED, "buffer native sol"]. Created as an empty account owned by the settlement program, whose lamports on top of rent pay out orders buying native SOL.

args.name: manager
docs: The initial holder of the Manager role: the account authorized to transfer any role.

args.name: solver_authority
docs: The initial holder of the SolverAuthority role: the account authorized to add and remove solvers.

args.name: reclaim_authority
docs: The initial holder of the ReclaimAuthority role: the account authorized to close buffer accounts and reclaim their rent.

args.name: settlement_owned_order_authority
docs: The initial holder of the SettlementOwnedOrderAuthority role: the account authorized to place orders that sell the protocol's own buffer balances.

instructions.name: create_buffer
docs: Creates one or more per-token buffer PDAs (token accounts) in a single instruction.

Every buffer is created under the token program that owns its mint, and the instruction names a single token_program for those CPIs to dispatch to, so mints spread across both supported token programs need one instruction each.

IDL LIMITATION: the real instruction accepts an unbounded number of (buffer_pda, mint) pairs as remaining accounts, one pair per buffer, with at least one pair required (CreateBuffer rejects zero buffers). IDL grammar has no 'repeated group' construct, so this file only declares the guaranteed index-0 template (buffer/mint_0).
Each buffer_pda_i must be the canonical PDA for seeds [SETTLEMENT_SEED, mint_i, "buffer"].

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The token program the created buffer PDAs are initialized through. Must be one of the supported token programs, and the one owning every mint this instruction is handed.

accounts.name: buffer
docs: Guaranteed present: CreateBuffer rejects an instruction with zero buffers.

accounts.name: mint_0
docs: Guaranteed present: CreateBuffer rejects an instruction with zero buffers.

instructions.name: create_order
docs: Allocates a per-order PDA and writes the initial OrderAccount body.

order_pda's canonical seeds are [SETTLEMENT_SEED, sha256(intent_bytes), "order"]. This is not expressible as a static `pda` entry because the middle seed is a hash of the entire `intent` argument, not a plain field/account reference, which is outside what the PDA-seed grammar can describe.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Must match intent.owner; authenticates the order.

accounts.name: created_by
docs: Funds the new order PDA's rent.

accounts.name: order_pda
docs: See the seed-derivation note above; cannot be auto-derived by IDL-driven tooling.

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Cancels an order so it can no longer be settled. Only the order owner may cancel.
If the order PDA doesn't exist yet, it's created already cancelled. For this, some arbitrary account needs to pay the rent and sign.
An existing order owned by the state PDA is cancelled by the SettlementOwnedOrderAuthority instead.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Must match intent.owner; authenticates the cancellation. For an order owned by the state PDA, must instead match the settlement_owned_order_authority recorded in state.

accounts.name: created_by
docs: Funds the order PDA's rent when the order is created cancelled; the program only requires its signature in that case. Unused when an existing order is cancelled.

accounts.name: order_pda
docs: The order to cancel. Its canonical seeds include sha256(intent), so it cannot be auto-derived by IDL-driven tooling.

accounts.name: state
docs: Required only to cancel an order owned by the state PDA; names the settlement-owned-order authority the signer is checked against. Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone.

instructions.name: create_settlement_owned_order
docs: Create an order on behalf of the state PDA. Used to sell fees accumulated in the buffer accounts through a regular settlement.

The order isn't authenticated by its owner: the owner is the settlement state PDA, which has no key. The settlement-owned-order authority signs instead, and the program forces intent.owner to be the state PDA, so a settlement-owned order can only sell funds the protocol controls (its buffer balances, which the state PDA owns). Once created it settles through the normal BeginSettle/FinalizeSettle flow.

order_pda's canonical seeds are [SETTLEMENT_SEED, sha256(intent_bytes), "order"]. This is not expressible as a static `pda` entry because the middle seed is a hash of the entire `intent` argument, not a plain field/account reference, which is outside what the PDA-seed grammar can describe.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must match the settlement_owned_order_authority recorded in the state PDA; authorizes the order without paying rent.

accounts.name: created_by
docs: Funds the new order PDA's rent and is recorded as the order's created_by, so ReclaimOrder refunds it there. May be the same account as authority.

accounts.name: state
docs: Names the settlement-owned-order authority the signer is checked against and is the owner every settlement-owned order is bound to. Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone.

accounts.name: order_pda
docs: See the seed-derivation note above; cannot be auto-derived by IDL-driven tooling.

instructions.name: begin_settle
docs: Pulls funds for a batch of orders. Must be paired in the same transaction with a FinalizeSettle at `finalize_ix_index`.

IDL LIMITATION: only the fixed-size prefix (finalize_ix_index, auction_id) is represented as typed arguments. After it, the real wire format is `[order_count: u8][transfer_count; order_count][amount: u64 LE; sum(transfer_count)]`, and each order adds `[order_pda, sell_token_account, sell_mint, destination; transfer_count]` accounts. A sell_mint set to the instructions sysvar selects Transfer instead of TransferChecked. Please check the rust documentation for more information.

accounts.name: solver
docs: The solver settling this batch. Must be present in the state PDA's solver list; only a registered solver may settle.

accounts.name: state
docs: Must be the canonical state PDA; holds the solver list `solver` is checked against, and signs each pull as the user's SPL delegate.

accounts.name: spl_token_program
docs: The legacy SPL Token program; one of two fixed token-program slots this settlement's pulls are issued against. A settlement whose pulls only touch Token-2022 may put any already-present account here.

accounts.name: token_2022_program
docs: The SPL Token-2022 program; the second fixed token-program slot. A settlement whose pulls only touch the legacy SPL Token program may put any already-present account here.

args.name: finalize_ix_index
docs: Index of the paired FinalizeSettle in this transaction. Little-endian, matching standard Borsh/Anchor u16 decoding.

args.name: auction_id
docs: The off-chain auction this settlement executes. Carried in the instruction data so the settlement can be tied back to its auction off-chain, unused on-chain.

instructions.name: finalize_settle
docs: Validates that a BeginSettle at `begin_ix_index` exists and points back at this instruction. Must not be called via CPI.

IDL LIMITATION: only the fixed-size prefix (begin_ix_index) is represented as a typed argument. After it, the real wire format is `[bump: u8; push_count][amount: u64 LE; push_count]`, where each bump is the canonical bump of the push's source: the buy mint's buffer PDA, or the native SOL buffer PDA for an order buying native SOL. Each push adds `[source_buffer, destination, mint]` accounts. A mint set to the instructions sysvar selects Transfer instead of TransferChecked. Please check the rust documentation for more information.

accounts.name: state
docs: Must be the canonical state PDA; signs each push as the buffers' SPL token authority.

accounts.name: spl_token_program
docs: The legacy SPL Token program; one of two fixed token-program slots this settlement's pushes are issued against. A settlement whose pushes only touch Token-2022 may put any already-present account here.

accounts.name: token_2022_program
docs: The SPL Token-2022 program; the second fixed token-program slot. A settlement whose pushes only touch the legacy SPL Token program may put any already-present account here.

args.name: begin_ix_index
docs: Index of the paired BeginSettle in this transaction. Little-endian, matching standard Borsh/Anchor u16 decoding.

instructions.name: reclaim_order
docs: Closes an order PDA and returns its rent lamports to the created_by account recorded in the order body.
Anyone may reclaim after now > valid_to, or before expiry if the order is completely filled.
Reclaiming a cancelled order that is not completely filled while now <= valid_to requires the stored intent owner's signature.

accounts.name: order_pda
docs: The order PDA to close. Its canonical bump is read out of the stored OrderAccount body, so no bump argument is needed.

accounts.name: reclaim_recipient
docs: Must match the created_by address recorded in the order; receives the recovered rent lamports.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Required only for cancelled, unexpired orders. Must match the stored intent owner and sign, independently of reclaim_recipient.

instructions.name: reclaim_buffer
docs: Closes one or more buffer PDAs and sends each closed buffer's rent lamports to a reclaim_recipient of the caller's choosing. Only the current holder of the ReclaimAuthority role recorded in the state PDA may authorize this. Each buffer carries a u64 burn limit in the instruction data: a buffer whose balance does not exceed its limit is burned to zero (when non-empty) and closed, while a balance above its limit is skipped so the rest of the batch still closes; the instruction reverts only when every buffer is over its limit. A zero limit forbids burning, so a non-empty buffer is closed only when the caller allows it with a non-zero limit. Any other failure, such as a non-canonical PDA or a burn or close that fails, reverts the whole instruction.

Every buffer is closed by the token program that owns it, and the instruction names a single token_program for those CPIs to dispatch to, so buffers spread across both supported token programs need one instruction each.

IDL LIMITATION: the real instruction accepts an unbounded number of (buffer_pda, mint) pairs as remaining accounts, one pair per buffer, with at least one pair required (ReclaimBuffer rejects zero buffers), and the instruction data carries one little-endian u64 burn limit per buffer in the same order. IDL grammar has no 'repeated group' construct, so this file only declares the guaranteed index-0 template (buffer/mint_0) and omits the per-buffer limits.
Each buffer_pda_i must be the canonical PDA for seeds [SETTLEMENT_SEED, mint_i, "buffer"]; mint_i is passed only so that derivation can be checked on-chain.

accounts.name: state
docs: Must be the canonical state PDA; holds the reclaim_authority the signer is checked against, and is the buffers' SPL token authority. Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone. SETTLEMENT_SEED is the ASCII prefix "settlement v" followed by the program's major.minor version, right-padded with spaces to a fixed 19 bytes; the fixed width prevents one version's seeds from being a prefix of another's.

accounts.name: reclaim_authority
docs: Must match the reclaim_authority address recorded in the state PDA.

accounts.name: reclaim_recipient
docs: Receives the rent lamports of every closed buffer.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The token program the buffer PDAs are closed through. Must be one of the supported token programs, and the one owning every buffer this instruction is handed.

accounts.name: buffer
docs: Guaranteed present: ReclaimBuffer rejects an instruction with zero buffers.

accounts.name: mint_0
docs: Guaranteed present: ReclaimBuffer rejects an instruction with zero buffers. Must be writable when this buffer's burn limit is non-zero, since burning decrements the mint's supply; read-only is enough for a zero-limit close.

instructions.name: transfer_authority
docs: Transfers a Role to another account: the signer names the new holder and the role's holder is updated immediately.
The signer must be either the manager or the current holder of the role being transferred.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Authorizes the transfer; must be the manager or the current holder of `role`.

accounts.name: state
docs: Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone. SETTLEMENT_SEED is the ASCII prefix "settlement v" followed by the program's major.minor version, right-padded with spaces to a fixed 19 bytes; the fixed width prevents one version's seeds from being a prefix of another's.

args.name: role
docs: The role to transfer, as its single wire discriminator byte.

args.name: new_authority
docs: Becomes the holder of `role` once the instruction succeeds.

instructions.name: add_solver
docs: Registers a solver, allowing that account to execute settlements. Only the current holder of the SolverAuthority role may authorize this, and a solver that is already registered is rejected.
The state PDA grows by one address, so the payer tops up its rent through a system-program transfer.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must match the solver_authority address recorded in the state PDA. Authorizes the change but doesn't pay for it.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Funds the rent of the state PDA's extra solver slot.

accounts.name: state
docs: Holds the solver authority the signer is checked against and the solver list the new solver is inserted into; grown by one address. Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone. SETTLEMENT_SEED is the ASCII prefix "settlement v" followed by the program's major.minor version, right-padded with spaces to a fixed 19 bytes; the fixed width prevents one version's seeds from being a prefix of another's.

args.name: solver
docs: The account to register as a solver.

instructions.name: remove_solver
docs: Removes a solver, preventing that account from executing settlements. Only the current holder of the SolverAuthority role may authorize this, and a solver that isn't registered is rejected.
The state PDA shrinks by one address, and the freed rent is paid to rent_recipient by a direct debit from the program-owned PDA, so no system program is involved.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must match the solver_authority address recorded in the state PDA. Authorizes the change but doesn't receive anything.

accounts.name: rent_recipient
docs: Receives the rent freed by shrinking the state PDA.

accounts.name: state
docs: Holds the solver authority the signer is checked against and the solver list the removed solver is taken from; shrunk by one address. Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone. SETTLEMENT_SEED is the ASCII prefix "settlement v" followed by the program's major.minor version, right-padded with spaces to a fixed 19 bytes; the fixed width prevents one version's seeds from being a prefix of another's.

args.name: solver
docs: The solver to remove.

instructions.name: withdraw_native_sol
docs: Moves lamports out of the native SOL buffer to a recipient of the caller's choosing. Only the current holder of the SettlementOwnedOrderAuthority role may authorize this, and the buffer's rent can't be withdrawn.
Lamports move by a direct debit from the program-owned buffer, so no system program is involved.

accounts.name: state
docs: Must be the canonical state PDA; holds the settlement_owned_order_authority the signer is checked against. Canonical PDA seeded by SETTLEMENT_SEED alone. SETTLEMENT_SEED is the ASCII prefix "settlement v" followed by the program's major.minor version, right-padded with spaces to a fixed 19 bytes; the fixed width prevents one version's seeds from being a prefix of another's.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must match the settlement_owned_order_authority address recorded in the state PDA.

accounts.name: native_sol_buffer
docs: The native SOL buffer created by Initialize; debited by the withdrawn amount, never below its rent.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: Receives the withdrawn lamports.

args.name: amount
docs: The maximum lamports to withdraw; capped to the buffer's balance above rent.

types.name: OrderAccount
docs: The body stored in an order PDA.

types.name: SettlementState
docs: The parameters used to initialize the state account. They are also the account's stored header, in wire order.

IDL LIMITATION: the sorted list of approved solvers that follows the header isn't declared here. It's a bare run of 32-byte addresses filling the rest of the account, with no length prefix for a vec type to read. add_solver inserts into it, keeping it sorted ascending by address so that it stays binary-searchable.

types.name: OrderIntent
docs: Order intent. Its canonical encoding, `EncodedOrderIntent`, is the exact wire format of create_order's `intent`
argument and the exact bytes hashed (SHA-256) to produce the order UID used in the order PDA's seeds. Field order
and encoding here are load-bearing: they must match this program's Rust definition exactly.

fields.name: flags
docs: IDL LIMITATION: this byte packs two settings the IDL's type grammar can't name as one field, so it's declared as the raw byte the wire carries. Bit 0 is reserved for future use and must be clear. Bit 1 is the OrderKind (0 = Sell, 1 = Buy). Bit 2 is partially_fillable.
Every other bit is reserved and must be clear: the program rejects a flags byte carrying one, so the same settings never have two encodings, and an order never has two UIDs.

types.name: OrderKind
docs: Direction of the trade. The discriminants are the values the kind bit of the encoded flags byte takes.

types.name: Role
docs: A transferable authority stored in the state PDA.
The discriminant is the wire value carried by the authority-transfer
instruction (see transfer_authority).

errors.name: FinalizeBeforeInitialize
errors.msg: The FinalizeSettle included as input to BeginSettle isn't before the actual BeginSettle index.

errors.name: BeginFinalizePairOverlap
errors.msg: Another BeginSettle/FinalizeSettle of this program appears strictly between this pair's bounds, nesting or overlapping two settlements.

errors.name: MissingCounterpartInstruction
errors.msg: The counterpart index points past the end of the transaction's instruction list, so no instruction sits there.

errors.name: CounterpartIsExternal
errors.msg: The instruction at the counterpart index belongs to a different program.

errors.name: InvalidCounterpartDiscriminator
errors.msg: The counterpart instruction's discriminator byte couldn't be recovered from its data.

errors.name: InvalidCounterpartCounterpart
errors.msg: The counterpart instruction's own counterpart index couldn't be recovered from its data.

errors.name: MismatchedCounterpartDiscriminator
errors.msg: The counterpart's discriminator isn't the expected BeginSettle/FinalizeSettle kind, or its counterpart index doesn't point back at this instruction.

errors.name: OwnerMismatch
errors.msg: An order-creation instruction's intent owner isn't the owner it must have: the signer for CreateOrder, the settlement state PDA for CreateSettlementOwnedOrder.

errors.name: AccountNotDerivable
errors.msg: An account was provided that cannot be derived from the seeds recognized by the program

errors.name: OrdersNotStrictlyIncreasing
errors.msg: BeginSettle's order accounts aren't passed strictly increasing by address.

errors.name: SellTokenAccountMismatch
errors.msg: A BeginSettle sell token account doesn't match the sell_token_account recorded in the order's intent.

errors.name: SellTokenAccountInvalid
errors.msg: A BeginSettle sell token account isn't a valid SPL token account (wrong data length or not owned by the token program).

errors.name: SellTokenOwnerMismatch
errors.msg: A BeginSettle sell token account's SPL owner isn't the order's intent owner.

errors.name: AccountCountNotMatchingOrderCount
errors.msg: BeginSettle's order-account count doesn't match the structure its instruction data expects: n orders each contribute an order PDA, a sell token account, a sell mint, plus one destination account per transfer.

errors.name: CalledViaCpi
errors.msg: BeginSettle or FinalizeSettle was invoked via CPI rather than as a top-level transaction instruction.

errors.name: OrderCancelled
errors.msg: A BeginSettle order has been cancelled by its owner and can no longer be settled.

errors.name: OrderExpired
errors.msg: A BeginSettle order's valid_to lies in the past: the order has expired and can no longer be settled.

errors.name: TransferCountMismatch
errors.msg: The transfer counts in BeginSettle don't sum to the number of transfer amounts, so destinations and amounts can't be paired up exactly.

errors.name: StateAccountMismatch
errors.msg: BeginSettle's state account isn't the canonical settlement state PDA, which must sign the pulls as the user's token delegate.

errors.name: AccountCountNotMatchingPushCount
errors.msg: FinalizeSettle's push-account count doesn't match its instruction data: each push contributes a source buffer, a destination, and a mint, so the count must be three times the number of push amounts.

errors.name: SettledOrderPushCountMismatch
errors.msg: BeginSettle: the number of pushes carried by the paired FinalizeSettle doesn't equal the number of settled orders. Each order must be paid by exactly one push.

errors.name: PushDestinationMismatch
errors.msg: BeginSettle: a paired FinalizeSettle push doesn't send its proceeds to the order's buy token account; its destination differs from the buy_token_account in the order's intent.

errors.name: PushSourceNotBuffer
errors.msg: BeginSettle: a paired FinalizeSettle push doesn't draw funds from the canonical buffer for the order's buy_mint.

errors.name: SellMintMismatch
errors.msg: BeginSettle: the OrderIntent sell_token_account holds a different mint than the declared sell_mint.

errors.name: LimitPriceViolated
errors.msg: BeginSettle: a settled order's executed price (amount_out/amount_in) is worse than the order's limit price (buy_amount/sell_amount).

errors.name: PullAmountOverflow
errors.msg: BeginSettle: an order's pull amounts sum to more than u64::MAX.

errors.name: FillExceedsOrderAmount
errors.msg: BeginSettle: filling this order would consume more tokens than the maximum the user is willing to trade on this intent. Sell: amount_in > sell_amount; buy: amount_out > buy_amount.

errors.name: OrderNotExactlyFilled
errors.msg: BeginSettle: a non-partially_fillable order isn't filled exactly to its amount (either under- or over-filled). Sell: amount_in != sell_amount; buy: total amount_out != buy_amount.

errors.name: AmountWithdrawnOverflow
errors.msg: BeginSettle: the order's cumulative amount_withdrawn would exceed u64::MAX once this settlement's pulls are added.

errors.name: AmountReceivedOverflow
errors.msg: BeginSettle: the order's cumulative amount_received would exceed u64::MAX once this settlement's push is added.

errors.name: OrderNotReclaimable
errors.msg: ReclaimOrder was called on an order that has not yet become eligible for reclaim.

errors.name: ReclaimRecipientMismatch
errors.msg: ReclaimOrder's reclaim_recipient account doesn't match the created_by address recorded in the order.

errors.name: ReclaimAuthorityMismatch
errors.msg: ReclaimBuffer's reclaim_authority account isn't a signer, or doesn't match the reclaim_authority address recorded in the settlement state PDA.

errors.name: ReclaimBufferNotCanonical
errors.msg: A ReclaimBuffer buffer_pda doesn't sit at the canonical buffer PDA derived from its paired mint.

errors.name: UnauthorizedAuthorityTransfer
errors.msg: TransferAuthority's signer is neither the manager nor the current holder of the role being transferred, so it may not transfer it.

errors.name: UnauthorizedSolverManagement
errors.msg: AddSolver/RemoveSolver's solver-authority account isn't a signer, or doesn't match the solver_authority recorded in the settlement state PDA, so it may not change the solver list.

errors.name: SolverAlreadyExists
errors.msg: AddSolver's solver is already in the state PDA's solver list.

errors.name: UnauthorizedSolver
errors.msg: BeginSettle's solver account isn't a signer or isn't in the state PDA's solver list, so it may not settle.

errors.name: SolverNotFound
errors.msg: RemoveSolver's solver isn't in the state PDA's solver list.

errors.name: BufferSizeUnavailable
errors.msg: CreateBuffer asked the token program how long a token account for a mint has to be and couldn't read the answer, so it can't size the buffer.

errors.name: InvalidTokenProgram
errors.msg: The token program for a given token or mint is not supported.

errors.name: UnauthorizedSettlementOwnedOrder
errors.msg: CreateSettlementOwnedOrder's settlement-owned-order-authority account isn't a signer, or doesn't match the settlement_owned_order_authority recorded in the settlement state PDA.

errors.name: ZeroOrderAmount
errors.msg: An intent has a zero sell or buy amount, which is not supported.

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: A mint account supplied to BeginSettle or FinalizeSettle was not able to be parsed as such.

errors.name: PushSourceIsDestination
errors.msg: BeginSettle: a paired FinalizeSettle push's destination is the very buffer the push draws from, so settling it would move no funds yet still record the declared amount as received.

errors.name: NativeSolBufferEmptied
errors.msg: Moving lamports out of the native SOL buffer would empty it, which the runtime would then delete.

errors.name: ReclaimBufferBurnLimitExceeded
errors.msg: A buffer to be reclaimed holds more tokens than the burn limit supplied for it, so its balance can't be cleared for closing.

errors.name: UnauthorizedNativeSolWithdrawal
errors.msg: WithdrawNativeSol's authority account isn't a signer, or doesn't match the settlement_owned_order_authority recorded in the settlement state PDA.

errors.name: NativeSolBufferMismatch
errors.msg: WithdrawNativeSol's native SOL buffer account isn't the canonical native SOL buffer PDA.
